import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import compiler
from compiler import participant_distance, Router, _adjacency, _candidate_orders, _decompose_trees, _origin_orders
m=24
links=[(i,i+1) for i in range(m-1)]
parts=[(i,1) for i in range(m)]
caps=[24]*(m-1)
n=m
dist,pdist=participant_distance(n,links,parts,caps)
names=[p[0] for p in parts]
adj,Cset=_adjacency(n,links,caps,parts)
router=Router(n,links,caps); recipes=[];memo={}
origins=_origin_orders(n,links,caps,parts)[0]
print('origins[:5]',origins[:5])
for (v,rv) in origins:
    others=[w for w in names if w!=v]
    ok=None; fails=[]
    for order in _candidate_orders(v,others,dist,adj,Cset,pdist):
        if set(order)!=set(others) or len(order)!=len(others): continue
        saved=list(router.res)
        res=compiler._deliver(router,v,rv,order,names,n,dist,recipes,memo,False,pdist)
        if res is None:
            fails.append(('D',tuple(order[:4]))); router.res=saved; continue
        recs=_decompose_trees(v,rv,res[0],parts)
        if recs is None:
            fails.append(('X',)); router.res=saved; continue
        ok=res; break
    if ok is None:
        print('origin',v,'FAIL',fails[:3]); break
else:
    print('ALL OK')
"
